integrity: Proof uses complete parameter enumeration, two independently coded smoothness tests and an exact base-scheme certificate; computations are included and reproducible. The review is self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for one cyclic-quartic degree-five del Pezzo surface over F2. No claim about other twists, all fields, or any independent priority certification. A prior unindexed arithmetic census cannot be ruled out.
title: Four all-smooth anticanonical pencils on the cyclic quartic quintic del Pezzo surface over \(\mathbf F_2\)
